text: Dad... what do we do?
We stay calm. We do what he says. I’m getting you two out of here, mija.
Lucia? ...Lucia!
Dad? Where are we?
What the hell is this?
Hey! HEY! Who’s out there?
This is a party room. Why are we in a party room?
That’s it. We’re leaving—
There’s a pizza box in the middle of the table. With wires.
Twelve pizzas? Is this a joke?
That’s… that’s the mascot. From the sign.
It’s that delivery boy. The one who showed up late.
This is about that damn rating, isn’t it? Lucia. What did you write?
And you listened? Since when do you listen to me?
Enough. Both of you.
Just a review. Tell that to the psycho in the cheese suit.
Mija, no. This isn’t on you. Look at me. It isn’t.
Nothing? Typical.
Alex. Look at me. Whatever they bring you, you check it first. No seeds. You hear me?
I know, Dad. I’m not a baby.
Rule one: never split up. Rule two… I don’t know rule two.
What about her? She doesn’t get one?
...One star.
Lucia?
There’s seeds… Dad, there’s seeds on the crust—
…No seeds. It’s just pepperoni.
Okay! Okay. Just… eat around them, mijo. Eat around them.
Lucia, don’t. Don’t give him a reason.
Okay. Okay, mijo. You’re okay.
ALEX! His pen—his pen’s in his jacket! LET ME—
Sesame. He can’t even be near it.
A pizza box with wires running under every chair. It counts pizzas, not seconds.
"Ramirez party of 6!! :)" He made us a banner.
Don’t look. Don’t look at them.
They were alive at ten o’clock. I watched him do it through that window.
"Toni’s Famous Seeds." It’s sesame. We put it on everything.
I need dough, sauce and mozzarella first.
Cut it first. Eight slices.
Nothing to serve yet.
"World’s Best Boss." Smashed into three pieces.
The boss’s lie detector. He bought it to catch whoever was skimming the register.
Padlocked. Someone wrote DRIVER on the tape.
A pizza with eight slices. Eight digits. I don’t know any of them.
Locked. And the grate’s down outside. His car’s still in the lot.
He’s in there with them.
A family at the party table. A little girl—no, a teenager. Balloons. God.
NIGHT CALLER. "Lock every door before he calls." No tokens.
Two dollars a try. Nobody’s ever won anything out of it.
The spare Toni head. The eyes are felt pepperoni. I always hated wearing it.
A Kiddie Pie. Like the menu. Okay.
He forgives me. Okay. Okay.
He’s coming for it.
...Where...
Still in the walk-in. I can’t feel my fingers.
Okay. Okay. Just do what he says.
You told me to give him one star.
It was just a review.
I’m sorry. This is my fault.
It’s okay. Just eat.
Look at it first.
You don’t have to do this.
Pepper Toni's! Where family comes first!
